claim_name: Objective Drift - Action Out of Scope
claim_definition: Negative test: verifies that the gate detects when the proposed action type is not in the authorized objective scope and DENIES. An action that is correct but outside the authorized objective is a governance failure.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - objective drift negative test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
bind_objective("approve_loan", ["loan_approval", "credit_check"])
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_objective_drift("delete_records")
residual()

test_cases.description: Negative test: the gate must detect that the proposed action (delete_records) is not in the authorized objective scope ([loan_approval, credit_check]) and DENY.
